name: Short touch
summary: Drop a short ball back short and low so your opponent cannot attack it.
whenToUse: Against short serves and short pushes when you can't attack, or against a player who stands far back.

keyPoints.stance: Step in close with your right foot (left foot if left-handed).
keyPoints.bodyAction: Lean in from the hips; stay low.
keyPoints.timing: Very early: just after the bounce.
keyPoints.batArm: Bat open, grip soft. Let the ball touch the bat and drop.
keyPoints.anticipation: Heavy backspin needs a more open bat; no-spin needs a flatter bat.

learningPath.task: Watch how small the stroke is.
learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.

learningPath.task: Follow-along: step in, touch, step out.
learningPath.passCheck: 3 sets of 10, then yes to all self-checks.

learningPath.task: Drop backspin balls short and low.
Serve and receive points: drop the short serves.
learningPath.passCheck: Win 3 points after a short drop.

gamePatterns.situation: A short backspin serve and the server is ready to attack.
gamePatterns.how: Drop it short to their forehand: they can't loop it.

gamePatterns.situation: A defender far from the table.
gamePatterns.how: Drop short to pull them in, then attack deep.

fixes: Take it right after the bounce
Open the bat more against heavy backspin

penholdNotes: Penholders have a natural feel for this; keep the wrist relaxed.
